question: Should this PR land with bundled Fireworks Kimi models sending session-affinity headers by default, and should the custom-config schema companion be paired in the same release window?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but changing default provider-facing headers and deciding schema parity are compatibility/product choices that automation should not make.

options.title: Accept Fireworks affinity default
options.body: Land this PR as-is if maintainers intentionally accept stable affinity identifiers for the two bundled Fireworks Kimi model rows.

options.title: Pair the schema companion
options.body: Land or fold in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92359 if custom provider configs should accept the same compat flag in the same release window.

options.title: Defer bundled opt-in
options.body: Keep the transport parity fix but remove or delay the Fireworks manifest flags if default provider-facing affinity headers are not acceptable yet.

recommendation.title: Accept Fireworks affinity default
recommendation.body: Land this PR as-is if maintainers intentionally accept stable affinity identifiers for the two bundled Fireworks Kimi model rows.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has adjacent provider/runtime history and is the best available owner for the default-header product decision among the likely owners.
